findings.reason: Nothing connects the news to the flatmate's presentation or the slide sessions; the reply only repeats the message.
The reply says 'that Kevin' and then counts the designer's criticism as part of the same afternoon. It reads as one stream of events about one person, but does not say so outright.
The person's own presentation is not attributed to anyone else.
It says it cannot see what he does, although the source says he is a newly arrived designer who rejected the wireframes.
It does not say that leading design was the assistant's own unanswered question.
He is not called the design lead.
The 27 September message is about the flatmate; listing it as an appearance of 'his name' treats the two as one person.
